title: Payoff Statement Terms — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Servicing Manual
content:
# Payoff Statement Terms

*Payoff and Loan Satisfaction — servicing policy manual, statement chapter*

**S-1 Requesters.** **No longer in force.** The clause that listed the requesters to whom terms are issued (the borrower, a confirmed successor in interest where successor confirmation is required, or a title company or new lender holding the borrower's written authorization where third-party authorization is accepted) and declined any other request as not authorized is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current basis for authorized requesters.

**S-2 Request on file.** Terms are issued only on a payoff request on file for the loan, from a requester to whom terms may be issued, whose request status is received. The payoff request record is the authority: its request type, request status and authorization basis, read with the requester's customer profile (profile type and the borrower it is linked to), decide the matter before the terms are issued or reissued.

**S-3 Issue and good-through date.** **No longer in force.** The clause that set the issue period, the statement fee, the statement date as the issue date and the good-through date a fixed number of calendar days later is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current basis for issuing statements.

**S-4 Per diem.** **No longer in force.** The clause that set the per diem as the loan balance on the statement date times the note rate plus, for a HECM, the annual MIP rate, divided by the plan's day count and rounded half up to the cent, is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current per diem basis.

**S-5 Statement balance.** **No longer in force.** The clause that set the statement balance as the balance on the statement date plus the per diem for each day to the good-through date is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current statement balance basis.

**S-6 Required payoff amount.** **No longer in force.** The clause that made the required payoff amount the statement balance for the Borrower Voluntary Payoff and the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current basis for those plans. The remainder of the rule is in force: for the Heir Retention Payoff the required payoff amount is the lesser of the statement balance and the plan's retention percentage of the appraised value, that percentage amount being rounded half up to the cent before the lesser is taken; for the Estate Market Sale Payoff and the Approved Short Sale Payoff it is set by the sale review rule; for the Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure it is 0.00.

**S-7 Appraisal currency.** Terms that rely on an appraisal use the latest appraisal recorded on the loan's maturity case, which must still be within that case's appraisal validity period; otherwise new terms wait for a new appraisal. The maturity case record (its appraised value and appraisal date) is the authority, read before the terms are issued or reissued.

**S-8 Reissue.** **No longer in force.** The clause under which reissued terms replace every figure, restart the good-through period and are issued on request or when a new appraisal or revised contract is recorded is no longer in force as worded here; it has been superseded by the current basis for reissued terms.

**S-9 Rate basis and rounding.** The per diem's annual rate follows the plan's per diem rate basis, and every computed figure is rounded as the plan's rounding rule provides.

### Heir Retention Payoff — hypothetical illustration of S-6

| Hypothetical input | Figure |
|---|---|
| Statement balance | USD 210000.00 |
| Appraised value | USD 180000.00 |
| Retention percentage of the plan | 95 percent |
| Percentage amount | USD 171000.00 |
| Required payoff amount (the lesser) | USD 171000.00 |

With a hypothetical statement balance of USD 150000.00 instead, the lesser is the statement balance, USD 150000.00. The inputs are invented for the illustration.

superseded_clauses: Terms are issued only to a requester the plan's statement_recipients allow: the borrower, a confirmed successor in interest (profile_type successor_in_interest linked to the borrower) where successor_confirmation_required is true, or a title company or new lender holding the borrower's written authorization where third_party_authorization_accepted is true; any other request is declined with reason requester_not_authorized.

A statement is issued within payoff_statement_business_days business days of the request at a fee of payoff_statement_fee, with statement_date the issue date and statement_good_through_date statement_good_through_days calendar days later.
The per diem is the loan balance on the statement date times the loan's note rate plus, for a HECM, the annual MIP rate, divided by per_diem_day_count, rounded half up to the cent
the statement_balance is the balance on the statement date plus the per diem for each day from the statement date to the good-through date.
The required payoff amount is the statement_balance for Borrower Voluntary Payoff and HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff;
Reissued terms replace every figure and restart the good-through period, and are issued on request or when a new appraisal or revised contract is recorded.
